## Type of change

## Checklist

- [ ] `pnpm build && pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint` pass locally
- [ ] `pnpm test` passes (new/changed behavior is covered by tests)
- [ ] Parsers that read untrusted input keep bounds checks and security caps
- [ ] No third-party code/algorithms copied (clean-room policy — see `plan.md`)
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated under `[Unreleased]` if user-facing
